qcdsDefinition.Quality: 単体テスト、代表シナリオ、runtime 近似テスト、MV3 runtime gate、プライバシー境界、文字化け検査、追跡性を含む実装品質。
qcdsDefinition.Cost: 依存関係の少なさ、権限範囲、runtime 負荷、保守コスト。
qcdsDefinition.Delivery: README/docs 整合、リリースチェックリスト、docs ZIP、検証証跡、GitHub 公開準備。
qcdsDefinition.Satisfaction: ユーザー操作性、Side Panel の分かりやすさ、手動テスト準備、残作業の少なさ。

notes: Quality is A- because unit tests, representative scenarios, runtime messaging tests, MV3 runtime gate, mojibake check, and docs ZIP generation pass.
Delivery is A- because repository docs, release checklist, QCDS metrics, local Issues/Tasks, generated evidence, and commit/push status are synchronized.

Satisfaction is A- because Side Panel startup no longer resets counts, replay failures are visible, and target video, A-B repeat, infinite mode, stop-after-current, toolbar action, and keyboard shortcut are implemented.
